name: shelfdock
description: A calm shelf for files, clipboard, and connected machines.
author: LexiLominite

scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux-arm: npm run build && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --arm64 --publish never
scripts.test:ui: node tests/ui/flows.cjs && node tests/ui/clipboard.cjs && node tests/ui/clipboard-sync.cjs && node tests/ui/mac-install.cjs && node tests/ui/optional-tools.cjs && node tests/ui/received.cjs && node tests/ui/updates.cjs && node tests/ui/focus.cjs && node tests/ui/onboarding.cjs
